# Overview

## Code Description

This script contains code that imports cleaned data generated via script-1_clean-data.Rmd, and then conducts three sets of analyses: one on demographics, one on plasma biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease, one on neuropsychological measures of verbal memory. Finally, the script exports data to be used in trial-level analyses.

Input(s):

  * SPSS file (.sav) containing cleaned Session 2 (task) data.

Output(s):

  * Three images (.pdf) showing differences in plasma biomarkers between APOE e4 carriers and non-carriers.
  * CSV file (.csv) containing key demographic and biomarker data for the trial-level analysis. 
  * Text file containing IDs for the demographic and biomarker analysis.

Note: Identifiable information (e.g., file names, subject IDs) have been replaced by placeholders (e.g., subject IDs appear as XXXX).

# Packages

Load packages.
```{r, message = FALSE}
# package versions are listed to aid de-bugging - you should not need these exact versions
library(haven) # version 2.5.4
library(tidyr) # version 1.3.1
library(dplyr) # version 1.1.4
library(readr) # version 2.1.5
library(stringr) # version 1.5.1
library(rstatix) # version 0.7.2
library(effectsize) # version 0.8.6
library(BayesFactor) # version 0.9.12-4.7
library(ggplot2) # version 3.5.0
library(Cairo) # version 1.6-2
library(ggpubr) # version 0.6.0
source("R_rainclouds.R") # note that this is a separate downloaded file
```

# Import Data

Import data.
```{r}
task <- read_sav("insert-file-name.sav")
```

# Demographics

## APOE e4

Count the number of APOE e4+/e4-.
```{r}
task %>% count(as_factor(apoe4_allele))
```

Relabel the APOE e4+/- variable and adjust the contrast so e4- is the reference.
```{r}
task <- task %>% 
  mutate(apoe4_allele = factor(apoe4_allele)) %>%
  mutate(apoe4_allele = recode(apoe4_allele, `-1` = "e4+", `1` = "e4-")) 
```

## Age

Convert age to numeric.
```{r}
task$s2_age <- as.numeric(task$s2_age)
```

Calculate age statistics.
```{r}
task %>%
  group_by(apoe4_allele) %>%
  summarise(mean = round(mean(s2_age), 1),
            sd = round(sd(s2_age), 1))
```

Conduct Welch's t-test to examine differences in age.
```{r}
t.test(s2_age ~ apoe4_allele, data = task)
```

Calculate cohen's d for differences in age.
```{r}
cohens_d(s2_age ~ apoe4_allele, data = task) 
```

Run a two-sides JZS Bayes Factor (BF) test for differences in age.
```{r}
ttestBF(formula = s2_age ~ apoe4_allele, data = task) 
```

## Handedness

Convert handedness scores to integer, then create a new variable `right_hand` that identifies participants who were deemed right-handed (score of 61 or above).
```{r}
task <- task %>% 
  mutate(hand = as.integer(hand)) %>%
  mutate(right_hand = case_when(
    hand > 60 ~ "yes",
    hand <= 60 ~ "no"))
```

Calculate handedness statistics.
```{r}
task %>%
  group_by(apoe4_allele) %>%
  summarise(yes = sum(right_hand == "yes"),
            no = sum(right_hand == "no"),
            prop_yes = yes / (yes + no),
            perc_yes = round(prop_yes * 100, 1))
```

Generate a contingency table for handedness.
```{r}
hand_table = table(task$right_hand, task$apoe4_allele)
```

Conduct chi-square test to examine differences in handedness.
```{r}
chisq.test(hand_table, correct = F) 
```

Calculate Cramer's V for differences in handedness.
```{r}
cramer_v(task$right_hand, task$apoe4_allele) 
```

Run a Bayes factor analysis.
```{r}
contingencyTableBF(hand_table, sampleType = "indepMulti", fixedMargin = "cols") 
```

Remove table from environment.
```{r}
rm(hand_table)
```

## Hormonal Birth Control

Calculate hormonal birth control statistics.
```{r}
task %>% 
  group_by(apoe4_allele) %>%
  summarise(yes = sum(current_hbc_med_use == -1, na.rm = T),
            no = sum(current_hbc_med_use == 1, na.rm = T),
            na = sum(is.na(current_hbc_med_use)),
            freq = yes / (yes + no),
            perc = round(freq * 100, 1))
```

Generate a contingency table for hormonal birth control.
```{r}
hbc_table = table(task$current_hbc_med_use, task$apoe4_allele)
```


Calculate Cramer's V for differences in hormonal birth control.
```{r}
task <- mutate(task, current_hbc_med_use = as.character(current_hbc_med_use))
cramer_v(task$current_hbc_med_use, task$apoe4_allele) 
```

Run a Bayes factor analysis.
```{r}
contingencyTableBF(hbc_table, sampleType = "indepMulti", fixedMargin = "cols") 
```

Remove table from environment.
```{r}
rm(hbc_table)
```

## Hormonal Replacement Therapy

Amend the values for two participants who were initially listed as HRT users but, after further inspection, are not.
```{r}
# check old value, then replace
task$hrt_use[task$id == "XXXX"] # 2 (Yes, currently) 
task$hrt_use[task$id == "XXXX"] <- 1 # No

# check old value, then replace
task$hrt_use[task$id == "XXXX"] # 2 (Yes, currently) 
task$hrt_use[task$id == "XXXX"] <- 1 # No
```

Calculate current HRT use statistics.
```{r}
task %>% 
  group_by(apoe4_allele) %>%
  summarise(yes = sum(hrt_use == 2, na.rm = T),
            no = sum(hrt_use == 1 | hrt_use == 3, na.rm = T),
            na = sum(is.na(hrt_use)),
            freq = yes / (yes + no),
            perc = round(freq * 100, 1))
```

Generate a contingency table for HRT use.
```{r}
task <- task %>%
  mutate(hrt_current = case_when(
    hrt_use == 2 ~ "yes",
    hrt_use == 1 | hrt_use == 3 ~ "no",
    is.na(hrt_use) ~ NA))

hrt_table = table(task$hrt_current, task$apoe4_allele)
```

Conduct chi-square test to examine differences in current HRT use.
```{r}
chisq.test(hrt_table, correct = F) 
```

Calculate Cramer's V for differences in current HRT use.
```{r}
cramer_v(task$hrt_current, task$apoe4_allele) 
```

Run a Bayes factor analysis.
```{r}
contingencyTableBF(hrt_table, sampleType = "indepMulti", fixedMargin = "cols") 
```

Remove table from environment.
```{r}
rm(hrt_table)
```

## Menopause Status

Calculate statistics for menopause status.
```{r}
task %>%
  group_by(apoe4_allele) %>%
  summarise(pre_n = sum(s1_meno_group == 1, na.rm = T),
            peri_n = sum(s1_meno_group == 2, na.rm = T),
            post_n = sum(s1_meno_group == 3, na.rm = T),
            pre_freq = pre_n / (pre_n + (peri_n + post_n)),
            peri_freq = peri_n / (peri_n + (pre_n + post_n)),
            post_freq = post_n / (post_n + (pre_n + peri_n)),
            pre_perc = round(pre_freq * 100, 1),
            peri_perc = round(peri_freq * 100, 1),
            post_perc = round(post_freq * 100, 1))
```

Generate a contingency table for menopause status.
```{r}
meno_table = table(task$s2_meno_group, task$apoe4_allele)
```

Conduct a chi-square to test for differences in menopause status.
```{r}
chisq.test(meno_table, correct = F)
```

Calculate Cramer's V for differences in menopause status.
```{r}
task <- mutate(task, s2_meno_group = as.character(s2_meno_group))
cramer_v(task$s2_meno_group, task$apoe4_allele) 
```

Run a Bayes factor analysis.
```{r}
contingencyTableBF(meno_table, sampleType = "indepMulti", fixedMargin = "cols") 
```

Remove table from environment.
```{r}
rm(meno_table)
```

## Parental History of Alzheimer's Disease

One participant said yes to everything and gave diagnosis, but is listed as no under memory loss (checked separately). Amend.
```{r}
task$enrol_memo_loss_parent[task$id == XXXX] <- -1
```

Generate a variable for parental history of Alzheimer's.
```{r}
task <- task %>%
  mutate_at(vars(starts_with("enrol_memo")), as_factor) %>%
  mutate(alz_hist = case_when(
    enrol_memo_loss_parent == "Yes" & enrol_memo_loss_cause == "AD" & enrol_memo_doc_diag == "Yes" ~ "Yes",
    .default = "No"))
```

Calculate parental history statistics.
```{r}
task %>% 
  group_by(apoe4_allele) %>%
  summarise(yes = sum(alz_hist == "Yes", na.rm = T),
            no = sum(alz_hist == "No", na.rm = T),
            freq = yes / (yes + no),
            perc = round(freq * 100, 1))
```

Generate a contingency table for parental history.
```{r}
alz_table = table(task$alz_hist, task$apoe4_allele)
```

Conduct chi-square test to examine differences in parental history.
```{r}
chisq.test(alz_table, correct = F) 
```

Calculate Cramer's V for differences in parental history.
```{r}
cramer_v(task$alz_hist, task$apoe4_allele)
```

Run a Bayes factor analysis.
```{r}
contingencyTableBF(alz_table, sampleType = "indepMulti", fixedMargin = "cols") 
```

Remove table from environment.
```{r}
rm(alz_table)
```

Plot parental history of AD.
```{r}
task %>%
  group_by(apoe4_allele) %>%
  summarise(yes = sum(alz_hist == "Yes", na.rm = T),
            no = sum(alz_hist == "No", na.rm = T),
            freq = yes / (yes + no),
            perc = round(freq * 100, 1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = apoe4_allele, y = perc, fill = apoe4_allele)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11),
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "sans", face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "sans", face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 11),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11),
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "None",
        strip.text = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11)) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "APOE ε4 Carrier Status", labels = c("ε4+", "ε4-")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Parental History of AD (%)", lim = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#00AFBB", "#FC4E07"), labels = c("ε4+", "ε4-")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#00AFBB", "#FC4E07"), labels = c("ε4+", "ε4-")) 
```


# Alzheimer's Plasma Biomarker Analysis

## AB42-40 Ratio

Check NAs by session for AB42/40 ratio.
```{r}
task %>% count(is.na(ab42_to_ab40_s1), is.na(ab42_to_ab40_s2)) 
```

Create new dataframe for AB42/40 ratio, removing those who have no data at session 2.
```{r}
ab <- task %>% filter(!is.na(ab42_to_ab40_s2)) 
```

Check whether there were issues with AB42/40 at session 2.
```{r}
ab %>% count(str_detect(ad_biomarker_issues_notes_s2, "AB40")) 
ab %>% count(str_detect(ad_biomarker_issues_notes_s2, "AB42")) 
```

Exclude this participant.
```{r}
ab <- filter(ab, !str_detect(ad_biomarker_issues_notes_s2, "AB40")) 
```

Check distribution of values.
```{r}
hist(ab$ab42_to_ab40_s2)
```

Check for extreme outliers using boxplots.
```{r}
# boxplot across groups
boxplot(ab$ab42_to_ab40_s2) 

# boxplot by group
boxplot(ab$ab42_to_ab40_s2 ~ ab$apoe4_allele) 
```

Calculate AB42/40 statistics.
```{r}
ab %>%
  group_by(apoe4_allele) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(ab42_to_ab40_s2)),
            mean = round(mean(ab42_to_ab40_s2, na.rm = T), 3),
            sd = round(sd(ab42_to_ab40_s2, na.rm = T), 3))
```

Conduct Welch's t-test to examine differences in AB42/40.
```{r}
t.test(ab42_to_ab40_s2 ~ apoe4_allele, data = ab) 
```

Calculate cohen's d for differences in AB42/40.
```{r}
cohens_d(ab42_to_ab40_s2 ~ apoe4_allele, data = ab) 
```

Run a two-sides JZS Bayes Factor (BF) test for differences in AB42/40.
```{r}
ttestBF(formula = ab42_to_ab40_s2 ~ apoe4_allele, data = ab) 
```

Plot differences in AB42/42 ratio.
```{r}
set.seed(123)
ggplot(ab, aes(x = apoe4_allele, y = ab42_to_ab40_s2, fill = apoe4_allele)) +
  geom_flat_violin(aes(fill = apoe4_allele),
                   position = position_nudge(x = .1, y = 0),
                   adjust = 1.5, trim = TRUE, colour = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(x = as.numeric(apoe4_allele)-0.2, y = ab42_to_ab40_s2, colour = apoe4_allele),
             position = position_jitter(width = .07), size = 6, shape = 20, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = apoe4_allele, y = ab42_to_ab40_s2, fill = apoe4_allele),
               outlier.shape = NA, width = .15, colour = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11),
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "sans", face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "sans", face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 11),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11),
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "None",
        strip.text = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11)) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "APOE ε4 Carrier Status", labels = c("ε4+", "ε4-")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Plasma Aβ42/40 Ratio", limits = c(0.04, 0.14), breaks = seq(0.04, 0.14, by = 0.02)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#00AFBB", "#FC4E07"), labels = c("ε4+", "ε4-")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#00AFBB", "#FC4E07"), labels = c("ε4+", "ε4-")) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = 0.136, yend = 0.136, size = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.138, label = "*", size = 6)
```

Save the figure as a PDF.
```{r}
ggsave(filename = "input-file-name.pdf", width = 4.5, height = 3.5, device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
ggplot(tau, aes(x = apoe4_allele, y = p_tau231_s2, fill = apoe4_allele)) +
  geom_flat_violin(aes(fill = apoe4_allele),
                   position = position_nudge(x = .1, y = 0),
                   adjust = 1.5, trim = TRUE, colour = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(x = as.numeric(apoe4_allele)-0.2, y = p_tau231_s2, colour = apoe4_allele),
             position = position_jitter(width = .065), size = 6, shape = 20, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = apoe4_allele, y = p_tau231_s2, fill = apoe4_allele),
               outlier.shape = NA, width = .15, colour = "black") +
 theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11),
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "sans", face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "sans", face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 11),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11),
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "None",
        strip.text = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11)) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "APOE ε4 Carrier Status", labels = c("ε4+","ε4-")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Plasma P-tau 231") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#00AFBB", "#FC4E07"), labels = c("ε4+", "ε4-")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#00AFBB", "#FC4E07"), labels = c("ε4+", "ε4-")) 
```

# Neuropsych: Verbal Memory

Prepare the data for analysis. Start by standardising AB42/40 and chronological age, then change the coding scheme for APOE.
```{r}
# standardise
ab <- ab %>% 
  mutate(ab42_ab40_std = scale(ab42_to_ab40_s2, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE),
         s2_age_std = scale(s2_age, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(ab42_ab40_std = as.numeric(ab42_ab40_std),
         s2_age_std = as.numeric(s2_age_std))

# set contrasts
contrasts(ab$apoe4_allele) <- c(-1, 1)
```

## CVLT - Short-Delay Free Recall

Model the short-delay free recall as a function of APOE and AB42/40 while adjusting for age.
```{r}
sfr_mod <- lm(data = ab, formula = cvlt_sfr ~ apoe4_allele * ab42_ab40_std + s2_age_std) 
```

Plot the model to inspect issues with assumptions.
```{r}
plot(sfr_mod) 
```

Generate a summary.
```{r}
summary(sfr_mod) 
```

Plot the age association.
```{r}
ggplot(ab, aes(x = s2_age_std, y = cvlt_sfr, colour = apoe4_allele, fill = apoe4_allele)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, shape = 20, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11),
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "sans", face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "sans", face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 11),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11),
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.text = element_text(family = "sans", colour = "black", size = 11)) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Age (Z-Score)") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "CVLT Short-Delay Free Recall", limits = c(0, 16), breaks = seq(0, 16, by = 4)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#00AFBB", "#FC4E07"), labels = c("ε4+", "ε4-")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#00AFBB", "#FC4E07"), labels = c("ε4+", "ε4-"))
```


## CVLT - Long-Delay Free Recall

Model the long-delay free recall as a function of APOE, AB42/40 and age.
```{r}
lfr_mod <- lm(data = ab, formula = cvlt_lfr ~ apoe4_allele * ab42_ab40_std + s2_age_std) 
```

Plot the model to inspect issues with assumptions.
```{r}
plot(lfr_mod) 
```

Generate a summary.
```{r}
summary(lfr_mod)
```

## CVLT - Recognition

Model recognition as a function of APOE, AB42/40 and age.
```{r}
rg_mod <- lm(data = ab, formula = cvlt_rg ~ apoe4_allele * ab42_ab40_std + s2_age_std) 
```

Plot the model to inspect issues with assumptions.
```{r}
plot(rg_mod) 
```

Generate a summary.
```{r}
summary(rg_mod) 
```

# Export Data

Generate a new data frame containing key demographic data for use in trial-level analysis. 
```{r}
demo <- select(task, id, apoe4_allele, s2_age, ab42_to_ab40_s2, p_tau231_s2)
```

Export the new data frame as a csv.
```{r}
write_csv(demo, "input-file-name.csv")
```

Generate a new data frame containing IDs for the AB42/40 ratio.
```{r}
ab_id <- select(ab, id)
```

Export the new data frame as a text file.
```{r}
write_tsv(ab_id, "input-file-name.txt")
```
